prompt: Use the Blender tools to build a product shot of a coffee mug standing on a wooden table. The mug needs a handle and a ceramic look; the table a wood look. Light it with three-point lighting (key, fill, rim) and use a 50 mm camera that frames the mug well. Name the mug object Mug and the table object Table. Render at 640x360 to renders/shot.png. Keep the scene in scene.blend (the Blender tools save it there).
